limitations: Dated producer observation. Capture digests identify records retained by the producer; their bodies are not included here.
The separate Python implementation checks captured bytes within the same producer evidence lineage, not an independent organization or authenticated deployment attestation.
The current snapshot is also listed by its digest: ten verified entries represent nine distinct roots, not ten deployments.
Technical integrity and observed transport do not establish semantic truth, adoption, model fidelity, source authority or future availability.
No production signing key or external-model experiment is established. The reference package remains 0.2.0-proposed.

followupReadback.scope: Two clients from one workstation. Observed POP suffixes do not constitute global edge coverage. Earlier or intermediary responses were not available for comparison.

capture.scope: Eleven retained Node response bodies, their readback metadata, and five PowerShell body hashes and root/header observations. PowerShell response bodies were not retained separately.

declarationReadback.scope: Dated producer reads from one workstation. The archive was decoded and matched to the snapshot repository digest. This does not reconstruct earlier intermediary responses or establish a propagation duration.
